statement_map.email_excerpt: You reached out to sell your product with monthly and yearly plans on the same checkout page, to send customers to your own thank-you page after payment, and to find out how to add GST to your prices.
Following our guidance, you added a yearly price to your product, and you confirmed your checkout page now shows both the monthly and yearly options.

Following our guidance, you pasted your thank-you page link into the After purchase redirect option in your product's Pages settings and saved it, and after a test purchase you confirmed it took you straight to your thank-you page.
We explained that there is a tax setting for adding GST to your prices. This is not yet resolved.
Add your privacy policy link to the checkout footer (you mentioned you planned to do this that week, the week of our call).
We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.
